## About
M-B Auto Body & Paint is a family shop on S East End Ave in Pomona, run by Rigo and Henry, a father and son. We handle body repair, auto paint, collision repair, framework, fiber glass repair and computerized paint matching, and we do our own work in house.
Being in an accident is stressful enough. We try to keep the repair simple: an honest estimate, clear timing, and a car that looks like nothing happened. Insurance is welcome, and we work on most makes and models.
Our customers have given us a 5 star rating across 55 Google reviews. Come by or give us a call and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Collision and body repair: Body repair and auto collision repair, from bumpers and mirrors to bigger damage.
- Insurance claims: We help with insurance claims for your repair.
- Computer color match: Repaired panels are matched to the undamaged paint on your car.
- Framework: Frame repair as part of getting your car back on the road after a collision.
- Fiber glass repair: Repairs to fiber glass parts and panels.
- Custom paint: Custom paint jobs alongside repair work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance?
A: Yes. Insurance is welcome here, and we work on most makes and models.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call us or send a message through the contact form. Quotes are free.

Q: Do you handle smaller jobs like scratches and dents?
A: Yes. A customer told us she brings her cars here for everything from scratches and dents to full body repair and painting.

## What customers say
- "I highly recommend M-B Auto Body & Paint!

On Friday, September 11, I was driving on Central Avenue in Chino when a truck passed me in the opposite lane. A piece of 4x4 lumber came loose from the truck and completely took out the side mirror on my 2020 Mercedes GLC 350.

The driver and I pulled over, and he told me that his boss knew a body shop that could repair it. I was skeptical at first because I had heard how complicated and expensive it can be to replace and properly program a Mercedes mirror.

He took me to M-B Auto Body & Paint, where I met the owners, Rigo and Henry. They immediately put my mind at ease and assured me that they could repair everything within a few days and make it look as though nothing had ever happened. They even drove me to the rental-car office so I could pick up a vehicle.

On Tuesday morning, they called to tell me that my Mercedes was ready. When I arrived, I was extremely impressed. The replacement looked completely original, the paint matched perfectly, and every feature on the mirror worked exactly as it should.

Rigo and Henry went above and beyond throughout the entire process. They were honest, professional, helpful, and true to their word. I am extremely satisfied with the quality of their work and the excellent customer service I received.

If you need bodywork or paint repairs, I would recommend M-B Auto Body & Paint without hesitation. Thank you, Rigo and Henry, for making a stressful situation so much easier!" (Joseph B (Cali Joe), 5/5)
